import re, sys
from pathlib import Path
name, phrases = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
text = Path("skills/%s/SKILL.md" % name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
practice = Path("docs/shared/repo-standards-practice.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
forbidden = "git fetch origin <"
assert forbidden not in text, "SKILL must not recommend git fetch origin <sha>"
assert forbidden not in practice, "practice doc must not recommend git fetch origin <sha>"
m = re.match(r"---\n(.*?)\n---\n", text, re.S)
assert m, "missing frontmatter"
fm = m.group(1)
assert re.search(r"^name: %s$" % re.escape(name), fm, re.M), "frontmatter name"
assert re.search(r'^description: .+$', fm, re.M), "description"
assert re.search(r"^version: \d+\.\d+\.\d+$", fm, re.M), "version"
for marker in ("**Purpose**", "**Trigger**", "Last updated: "):
    assert marker in text, marker
for p in phrases:
    assert p in text, "missing: " + p
print("OK: " + name)
